verdict:
[Last call] NOT READY. The code is ready and the records are not. I spot-checked the security fixes in /Users/aldemirkonuk/Projects/wt-sessions and they hold.
- Websocket: `handleConnection` checks `isActiveMember` against a live `user_restaurant_access` read and refuses the house if that read fails. `handleSubscribeRestaurant` refuses a socket whose token names no house. `evictFromHouse` calls `socketsLeave` and clears the socket's stored metadata. There is no multi-instance adapter, so the in-memory metadata clear is enough.
- Removal paths: all four call both `evictFromHouse` and `cancelPendingInvitesFrom`: `removeMember`, `TeamService.deleteMember`, `leaveRestaurant`, and `deleteAccount` (which reads the active houses before the delete and loops over them after).
- Verifier and attacker numbers agree: gateway 464/464 tests, web 2835 passing, CLAIMS 368/368.

Why it is not ready: the provenance dispute is settled against round 3.
- Commit 8bfa353a4 exists in this repo's object store (read with `git show` from wt-sessions; no other worktree was touched). Its title is "feat(auth): /login and /register open on the endpaper — sketch 118 Direction B". It brackets ADR 0143 and ADR 0149 row 35 with "2026-09-19: sketch 118 = B, the endpaper (the founder's answer, over the README's recommended A)".
- The founder's own memory record (founder-sketch-decisions-106-115.md, which I read only; nothing was written) has these answers dated 2026-09-19: F1 "Per device (Recommended)", F2 "7 days (Recommended)", F3 "Show the chooser (Recommended)", F5 "Never via a house (Recommended)", and F4 = the chooser sits in the sketch-118 B endpaper shell.
- ADR 0143:36 and ADR 0149:117 in this worktree are the 2026-09-17 text that predates those brackets. Round 3 read an older record as a contradiction.

What is wrong as a result:
- ADR 0164 carries a false discrepancy note across three rounds (lines 72-143 and review-trail rows 571-573).
- ADR 0164 still lists F1-F5 as "not locked" (status line 3, lines 54-58 and 70).
- OD-124 and OD-125 are filed as open for questions the founder already answered. OD-125 states the false contradiction as fact.

Also flagged (not in must_fix):
- `deleteAccount`: if the `users` delete fails after the access rows are gone, the eviction loop never runs. The same ordering existed before this branch.
- Nothing was run live in a browser (Playwright) this round.
- The scenario harness still signs in without calling `switch-restaurant` (item 4). It fails closed.
- Deliberately left: the websocket connect-time race, and the seven-fallback-site count, which was not re-measured.
